declarations.name: theorem epsilon_square_from_roots
declarations.excerpt:
theorem epsilon_square_from_roots (r z t : F) (hr : r^2=2)
    (hz : z^8 = -1) (ht : t^4=2) (h2 : (2:F) ≠ 0) :
    ∃ a : F, a^2=1+r := by
  have hz0 : z≠0 := by
    intro h
    rw [h, zero_pow (by decide)] at hz
    exact (neg_ne_zero.mpr one_ne_zero) hz.symm
  have hr0 : r≠0 := by intro h; rw [h, zero_pow (by decide)] at hr; exact h2 hr.symm
  let i := z^4
  have hi : i^2 = -1 := by dsimp [i]; simpa [← pow_mul] using hz
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ : ∃ s : F, s^2=r := by
    have ht2 : r^2=(t^2)^2 := by rw [hr, ← pow_mul]; exact ht.symm
    rcases (sq_eq_sq_iff_eq_or_eq_neg.mp ht2) with h | h
    · exact ⟨t, h.symm⟩
    · refine ⟨i*t, ?_⟩
      rw [mul_pow, hi, neg_one_mul]
      exact h.symm
  let q := z^2+1/z^2
  have hq : q^2=2 := by
    dsimp [q]
    field_simp
    linear_combination hz
  let bp := z+1/z
  let bm := i*(z-1/z)
  have hbp : bp^2=2+q := by
    dsimp [bp, q]
    field_simp
    ring
  have hbm : bm^2=2-q := by
    have hv : (z-1/z)^2=q-2 := by
      dsimp [q]
      field_simp
      ring
    dsimp [bm]
    rw [mul_pow, hi, hv]
    ring
  have hquot (b : F) (hb : b^2=2+r) : (b/s)^2=1+r := by
    rw [div_pow, hb, hs]
    apply (div_eq_iff hr0).mpr
    linear_combination -hr
  have hqr : q=r ∨ q= -r := sq_eq_sq_iff_eq_or_eq_neg.mp (hq.trans hr.symm)
  rcases hqr with h | h
  · exact ⟨bp/s, hquot bp (by simpa [h] using hbp)⟩
  · exact ⟨bm/s, hquot bm (by simpa [h] using hbm)⟩

theorem explicit_half (r a : F) (hr : r^2=2) (ha : a^2=1+r)
    (h2 : (2:F) ≠ 0) (h7 : (7:F) ≠ 0) :
    ∃ x y m : F, y ≠ 0 ∧
      y^2=x^3-(3-r)^2*x ∧ 2*y*m=3*x^2-(3-r)^2 ∧
      m^2-2*x=1+r ∧ m*(x-(1+r))-y=2*r := by
  let u := a+r/a
  have hu := (half_parameter r a hr ha).2
  exact ⟨1+2*r-2*u, -2+10*r-(r+4)*u, 2-u,
    half_y_nonzero r u hr hu h2 h7, half_identities r u hr hu⟩

/-- Combined square-root and halving certificate, valid in the selected finite
residue fields. No characteristic-zero or analytic hypothesis is hidden here. -/
theorem explicit_half_from_roots (r z t : F) (hr : r^2=2)
    (hz : z^8 = -1) (ht : t^4=2)
    (h2 : (2:F) ≠ 0) (h7 : (7:F) ≠ 0) :
    ∃ x y m : F, y ≠ 0 ∧
      y^2=x^3-(3-r)^2*x ∧ 2*y*m=3*x^2-(3-r)^2 ∧
      m^2-2*x=1+r ∧ m*(x-(1+r))-y=2*r := by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := epsilon_square_from_roots r z t hr hz ht h2
  exact explicit_half r a hr ha h2 h7

theorem same_coset_residue (D : ℤ_[p]) (hD : ‖D‖=1) (P Q : IntegralCurve p D)
    (he : QuotientAddGroup.mk' (subgroup p D) (point p D hD P)=
      QuotientAddGroup.mk' (subgroup p D) (point p D hD Q)) :
    reduce p D P=reduce p D Q := by
  by_contra hr
  have hsep : ‖(P.1.1:ℚ_[p])-(Q.1.1:ℚ_[p])‖=1 ∨
      ‖(Q.1.2:ℚ_[p])-(P.1.2:ℚ_[p])‖=1 := by
    by_cases hx : PadicInt.toZMod P.1.1=PadicInt.toZMod Q.1.1
    · right
      have hy : PadicInt.toZMod Q.1.2≠PadicInt.toZMod P.1.2 := by
        intro hy
        exact hr (Subtype.ext (Prod.ext hx hy.symm))
      have hu := (residue_unit p (Q.1.2-P.1.2)).mp
        (by simpa only [map_sub,sub_ne_zero] using hy)
      simpa only [PadicInt.norm_def,PadicInt.coe_sub] using hu
    · left
      have hu := (residue_unit p (P.1.1-Q.1.1)).mp
        (by simpa only [map_sub,sub_ne_zero] using hx)
      simpa only [PadicInt.norm_def,PadicInt.coe_sub] using hu
  have hn := IntegralFormalSeparation318.separated_difference
    (NormedField.toAbsoluteValue ℚ_[p]) (ActualSplitOrbitEntry318.nonarchimedean p)
    (D:ℚ_[p]) (P.1.1:ℚ_[p]) (P.1.2:ℚ_[p]) (Q.1.1:ℚ_[p]) (Q.1.2:ℚ_[p])
    D.2 (nonsingular p D hD P) (nonsingular p D hD Q)
    P.1.1.2 P.1.2.2 Q.1.1.2 Q.1.2.2 hsep
  apply hn
  apply (QuotientAddGroup.eq_zero_iff (subgroup p D)).mp
  change (QuotientAddGroup.mk' (subgroup p D)) (point p D hD P-point p D hD Q)=0
  simpa only [map_sub,sub_eq_zero]

theorem code_injective (hp : p≠2) (D : ℤ_[p]) (hD : ‖D‖=1) :

  | some z =>

    | some t =>

  have he := ActualReciprocalParameters318.coefficient_unit p rho hr h7
